en.headline:
A question.
A spread. Your cards.
en.intro: Choose a layout, pick cards by hand, and explore their images before inviting an interpretation.
en.concept_title: A spread gives each card a place.
en.concept: A spread is a set of labelled positions. The same card can be considered through a different question at each position. Choose the layout before you draw.
en.demo_note: A small diagram using the app’s current API catalog. It does not draw cards or generate a reading. “Future” is the catalog’s position label, not a guarantee of what will happen.
en.features_title: You choose from the face-down table.
features: The current catalog includes a single card, Classic Trinity, Celtic Cross and other layouts. Each has its own number of cards, labels and guidance. Some positions draw from a specific card pool.

The app shuffles hidden cards behind the visible tiles. Tap a card to fill the next position; drag to move around the connected table. A selected tile is used once. Finish the required picks, then reveal the cards.
Cards can land upright or reversed. That orientation belongs to the dealt card and is retained with the table; it is not a reading generated by an AI.

The reading view brings your selected cards and position labels together. The web app prepares a prompt you can choose to open in an AI service; it does not automatically send a model request when you pick.
steps: Start drawing, choose a layout and confirm it. Read its description, then enter your own question or use the suggested prompt.
Tap face-down tiles until every position is filled. The table moves into the reading view after the last pick.
Reveal the selected cards and consider each position. You can inspect the artwork before choosing an interpretation.
Open in AI lets you choose ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini. Save exports a reading image; Seek again starts a new table.
en.library_title: A library of faces and backs.
en.library: Dreamy Aura, Modern Arcana and the 1909 Historic pack pair a face style with a matching back. You can also customize them separately and browse by Major Arcana or suit. These change the presentation; they do not change which card a position contains.
en.art_note: Original Dreamy Aura artwork used by this app: The Fool and The Star.
captions: The live spread catalog before a draw.
The real manual-picking table for a labelled sample question.
Current packs and suit filters in the library.
en.data_title: A private table, an explicit interpretation.
data: Drawing and revealing are browser interactions. Open in AI prepares your question and selected-card context for the provider you choose. Any subsequent conversation is with that service and its account terms.

The MCP-integrated version can attach a revealed card, request a brief reading or send the table into the current conversation. These host actions are different from the ordinary website; availability depends on the host connection.

The website stores the current table in this tab’s session storage, including hidden dealt cards, selected cards, reveal state and its pinned spread definition. Appearance preferences use local storage. This is not account sync or a permanent reading history.

The app loads cards, artwork URLs and spread definitions from the Tarot API. The standalone draw does not require your own model key, but it needs that catalog connection. Treat readings as reflection, not a prediction or professional advice.
en.run_note: Start Vite and use the URL it prints. By default the catalog comes from the hosted Tarot API. VITE_TAROT_API_URL can point at a compatible local or staging catalog; no model key is needed for manual drawing.
en.footer: A Frankie project by Songhai Fan

zh.headline:
一个问题，
一副属于你的牌阵。
zh.intro: 先选牌阵，亲手抽牌，看看牌面，再决定是否邀请一次解读。
zh.concept_title: 牌阵，让每张牌有一个位置。
zh.concept: 牌阵是一组带有含义的位置。同一张牌，放到不同位置，就对应不同的提问角度。抽牌之前，先选好你想探索的布局。
zh.demo_note: 这个小示意直接使用当前 API 目录中的位置标签，不会抽牌，也不会生成解读。“未来”是目录里的位置名称，并不是对将来事件的保证。
zh.features_title: 从朝下的牌桌里，亲手选择。
features: 当前目录有单张、经典三张、凯尔特十字等牌阵，各自有数量、位置标签与引导。有些位置只从指定牌池里选牌。
可见牌块背后的隐藏牌已经洗好。点一张，填入下一个位置；拖动可以移动连在一起的牌桌。同一张牌块只能选择一次。抽够数量后进入揭牌界面。
发好的牌可能正位或逆位。方向会跟随这张牌一起保留，它并不是 AI 生成的判断。
解读界面把选中的牌与位置放在一起。网页版准备好可交给 AI 的提示词，由你决定是否打开相应服务；点牌本身不会自动调用模型。
steps: 点“开始抽牌”，选一个布局并确认。读过说明，再输入自己的问题，或使用页面给出的提示。
轻点朝下的牌，依次填满位置。最后一张选完后，页面会进入揭牌界面。
揭开所选牌，结合位置看牌面。可以先看图像，再决定要不要解读。
“打开 AI”可选择 ChatGPT、Claude 或 Gemini。“保存”导出图片，“再次探索”开启新牌桌。
zh.library_title: 牌面与牌背，都可以慢慢挑。
zh.library: 迷幻极光、现代重绘与 1909 百年馆藏三个卡包，把牌面与牌背配成一组。也可以分开调整，按大阿卡纳或花色浏览。外观选择只改变呈现方式，不会改变某个位置已经选中的牌。
zh.art_note: 应用实际使用的迷幻极光原始牌面：愚人与星星。
zh.gallery_title: 当前 Aura 里的真实界面
captions: 抽牌前从服务端载入的牌阵目录。
为明确标注的示例问题打开的真实手动抽牌桌。
当前牌库里的卡包与花色筛选。
zh.data_title: 保留这局牌，明确地邀请解读。
data: 抽牌与揭牌在浏览器内进行。“打开 AI”会为你选择的服务准备问题与选中牌的上下文。之后的对话发生在那个服务中，适用它的账号与使用规则。
MCP 集成版可以附加已揭开的牌、请求简短解读，或把牌阵交给当前对话。这些能力属于宿主连接，与普通网页不同；能否使用取决于宿主集成。
恢复当前局，不等于长期档案
网页版把当前局存在本标签页的 session storage 中，包括隐藏发牌、已选牌、揭牌状态及锁定的牌阵定义。外观偏好存在 local storage。它不是账号同步，也不是永久的阅读历史。
牌、图片地址与牌阵定义来自 Tarot API。手动抽牌不需要你自己的模型 key，但仍需要连上牌库服务。把解读用作反思，不把它当成预测或专业建议。
zh.run_note: 启动 Vite 后，打开它打印的地址。默认连接线上 Tarot API；VITE_TAROT_API_URL 可指向兼容的本地或预发布目录。手动抽牌不需要模型 key。
zh.footer: Songhai Fan 的 Frankie 系列项目
